resources.string: Two quick chopping motions switch the flashlight on or off
Hold the phone and make two quick chopping motions, like Motorola\'s Fast flashlight, to switch the flashlight on or off. Works with the screen off too, at some battery cost.
⚠ Background running restricted: tap to allow
⚠ Background activity restricted: tap, then Battery → allow background activity
Samsung also has its own list the app cannot check: Settings → Device care (Battery and device care) → Battery → Background usage limits (App power management) → Never sleeping apps → add Chop Torch.
MIUI also has settings the app cannot check: Settings → Apps → Chop Torch → Autostart on, and Battery saver → No restrictions.
Calibration: records the accelerometer (and Motorola\'s chop sensor, if this phone has one) to a file, to tune the detector.
